testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect custom panel targets from a part document: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:280:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect custom panel targets from a part document ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And ribbon customization is open on the Ribbon tab with Part | Tools selected ✔ And the Part | Tools custom panel list is empty ✔ When the user opens the target tab selector ✔ Then the visible part targets include Tools, Manage, View, Environments, Collaborate and the final available command tab ✔ And they also include 3D Sketch, Construction, Edit Base Solid, Repair, Route, Render, Analysis, 3D Print, Freeform, Hidden Tab and BIM Content ✔ And the visible assembly targets include Mold Layout, Core/Cavity, Mold Assembly and Assemble ✔ And Part | Tools remains the selected target ✔ When the user closes the selector with Escape ✔ Then the selector closes without changing the target or custom panel list ✔ When the user closes customization without making changes ✔ Then the dialog closes and the part remains active
